locations.note: Nina's search for her missing father leads from Berlin to Moscow.
Opens in Berlin, where Nina's father vanishes after an attack at his museum.
The remote site of the 1908 Tunguska explosion is the key to the conspiracy.
The investigation follows evidence to Ireland.
Nina flies to Cuba on the trail of Vladimir's old expedition companion, who was transferred to a clinic there at Dr Charlesroi's request.
Nina's investigation reaches a remote temple in the Himalayas.
The journey reaches an isolated Antarctic research station.

routes.name: Nina's investigation
routes.note: Nina follows her vanished father's trail from Berlin to Moscow, the Tunguska blast site, a clinic in Cuba, a Himalayan temple and an Antarctic research station.

routes.name: Max's investigation
routes.note: Max's Ireland chapter runs in parallel to Nina's Cuba chapter; he reunites with her at the Antarctic finale.
